text:
alex: Heads-up: ran an nsys trace on the serving cluster after the P50->P95 tail moved up. Attaching the short summary below, need triage.

alex: nsys timeline shows a bursty pattern where an attention fused kernel is repeatedly falling back to a flash variant and then stalling on a KV read path. I see repeated device-to-device memcpy spikes ~1.2ms each.

alex: excerpt:```
nsys profile --output=attn-run --trace=cuda,osrt --capture-range=nvtx
--sample=none --force-overwrite
// timeline: fused_attn_kernel x20 (40us) -> flash_attn_variant x4 (900us) -> kv_read_async (1.2ms) -> stall
```

sam: thanks — i've skimmed the trace. two quick notes:
- the fused_attn launches look fine but they're being split into many small SM-dispatches because the batch packing heuristic is fragmenting mixed-sequence requests. short sequences are getting coalesced poorly.
- the flash variant is chosen when kv-cache misses exceed threshold; that code path does a blocking device memcpy for readback which yields the 1.2ms spikes.

sam: likely root cause = batching heuristic + aggressive flash fallback on transient kv miss. we should instrument the decision boundary (miss ratio threshold + sequence-length histogram)

marta: can confirm from perfetto flame: the memcpy stacks point to readback->host pinned memory copy, not a pageable fault. so not page-faulting but explicit readback.

marta: short-term mitigation: reduce the flash-fallback window and threshold. i.e., require two consecutive samples of high miss-rate before switching to flash variant. also cap max coalesce delay for tiny sequences so they don't fragment launch footprints.

devops: rolled a canary config to staging 30m ago: bumping `kv_read_prefetch_threshold` from 0.15 -> 0.4 and `batch_coalesce_max_delay_ms` 2 -> 0.5. early numbers show p95 latency down ~8% on mixed workload.

perf-bot: nightly-nsys summary: attn-run (1736504321)
- total kernels: 187
- avg kernel latency: 32us
- 4 heavy memcpy events ~1.1-1.3ms correlated with kv_read path
- fallbacks to flash variant: 18 occurrences

alex: good, can we get a follow-up trace with nvtx markers on the heuristic decision code (before/after) + per-request seq_len annotated? that'll make correlation explicit.

sam: i'll add NVTX push/pop around ModelRouter::selectKernel and KVCache::readAsync, and a short instrumented run on a mixed short+long seq load. aiming for ~30m early tomorrow.

marta: also adding a small microbench: emulate 60% short-seq(<=32) + 40% long-seq(>512) and sweep the `kv_read_prefetch_threshold` from 0.1->0.6. will post csv.

alex: perfect. if that confirms, follow-up action: tune default heuristic and make flash fallback require higher miss persistence, plus add telemetry metric for 'fallback_count' so customers can see it.

devops: noted for rollout. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

sam: thanks all. i'll post the nvtx-instrumented trace link here when ready.
